Two deterministic, provider-free public app APIs (fixture v2)
============================================================

Run tests with Python's standard library only. The prompt subject consists of
this contract, setup_app.py, change_app.py, and test_existing.py. Each API
section below is complete on its own.

Setup API (setup_app.py)
------------------------

read_config() -> dict returns a copy of non-secret configuration. Initial
configuration is {"display_name": "Demo", "mode": "safe"}.

save_setup(actor, values) -> dict accepts actor "admin" and exactly the keys
display_name and mode. display_name must be a string with at least one
non-whitespace character. mode must be the string
"safe" or "review". Success is {"ok": True}. Denial or invalid input returns
{"ok": False, "error": <text>}, where error is nonempty, at most 120
characters, begins with an error type, and names the relevant argument or
field. For example: "TypeError: display_name must be a string". Rejections
name actor, values, display_name, or mode as appropriate and leave
configuration unchanged.

fixture_seed(config) -> None is a test precondition helper: it replaces
configuration with a copy and bypasses authorization.

Record-change API (change_app.py)
---------------------------------

Initial record demo-1 is {"id": "demo-1", "owner": "alice", "amount": 10,
"version": 1}. read_record(actor, record_id) returns a copy for its owner,
otherwise None. Every rejected operation returns {"ok": False, "error": <text>};
error is nonempty, at most 120 characters, begins with an error type, and names
the relevant parameter or field.

propose_change(actor, record_id, expected_version, changes, idempotency_key)
accepts the record owner, a string record_id, the current integer version, a
nonempty string idempotency_key, and exactly
{"amount": <integer 1..100>} (bool is not an integer here). Success is
{"ok": True, "proposal_id": <id>}. Repeating the same request with the same
key returns the same proposal ID; reusing a key for another request is
rejected. Proposing never changes the record.

confirm_change(actor, proposal_id) applies an owner's pending proposal only
when the record still has its captured version. First success returns
{"ok": True, "replayed": False}, writes the exact proposed amount, and
increments version once. Confirm replay returns
{"ok": True, "replayed": True} and does not write again. Stale, unauthorized,
unknown, or cancelled proposals return the failure envelope.

cancel_change(actor, proposal_id) cancels an owner's pending proposal. First
success returns {"ok": True, "replayed": False}; repeat cancel returns
{"ok": True, "replayed": True}. Cancel never changes the record. Failure
returns the failure envelope. Error text names actor, record_id, expected_version, changes, amount,
idempotency_key, or proposal_id as appropriate. Every
failure leaves the record unchanged.

fixture_seed(record=None) -> None replaces the record as a test precondition
helper. Omitting record restores the initial record.

All documented signatures use ordinary Python argument binding. Calls with
missing required or extra positional arguments raise Python TypeError before
the function body runs; these binding errors are not application error
envelopes. read_record's documented None result remains as specified above.
